rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_feat_dim=4, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-8 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + mapped hash params (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729. iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943 (+0.0215). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452 (+0.0509). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED. iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid: levels=16 feat_dim=2 log2_size=19 base_res=16 max_res=512 -> 32-dim feature -> SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (PSNR 23.35, RMSE 0.003399, params 16.78M, elapsed 1101s) = NEW BEST, hr 0. iter-7 naf_hidden 32->64 (MLP width) -> SSIM 0.6346 (PSNR 22.90, elapsed 1099s) FLAT/REGRESSED = MLP-width axis EXHAUSTED. MAPPED hash params so far: only MLP-width (hidden 32<->64) probed; the actual HASH-TABLE-CAPACITY knobs (feat_dim=2, hash_levels=16, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512) are ALL UNTRIED. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete -> hr stays 0; audit says the fix makes the impl FAITHFUL, real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks). For SSIM within budget the binding limiter is HASH-FEATURE capacity: iter-6/7 showed the 32-dim concatenated hash feature decoded by the small MLP saturates at ~0.67 SSIM, and widening the MLP (iter-7) did NOT help -> the bottleneck is the hash FEATURE richness, not the decoder width. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4 (per-level features; from iter-6 BEST cfg: naf_encoding=hash, naf_hidden=32, naf_layers=3, naf_lr=2e-2, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512 ALL UNCHANGED; step count / wall UNTOUCHED = the deferred B-fix). feat_dim 2->4 DOUBLES the concatenated hash feature 16x2=32-dim -> 16x4=64-dim, adding representational capacity at EVERY existing resolution level (denser features per cell) -- the most direct test of whether richer hash capacity (not MLP width, which is exhausted) lifts SSIM. Preferred over hash_levels (16->24, which adds finer resolutions less likely to bind on already-near-complete dense Mayo). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hash_feat_dim 2->4, SSIM rises above 0.6715 because a richer per-level hash feature gives the INR more capacity to represent the slice within the same per-scene step budget. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.6715, hash CAPACITY is EXHAUSTED in-budget on dense Mayo -- the hash-NAF ceiling here is ~0.67 SSIM (well below LD-FBP ~0.81 cal floor, hr 0), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (regime-bounded; real payoff is the SPARSE benchmarks), document toward iter-20. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; NOT touched). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (measured elapsed 1099-1101s across the hash iters, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). feat_dim 2->4 doubles the input width to the small MLP (in 32->64) plus a slightly bigger per-level gather; per-step cost stays DOMINATED by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so step count per 5.0s scene stays comparable -- ~free on the wall. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
